title: Rockstar Mods Real Life Vehicles for GTA6 Miami Promo
description: Rockstar's marketing push for GTA6 is underway. According to IGN Games, modded real-life vehicles designed to look like GTA6 cars have been spotted driving through Miami.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Brings GTA6 to the Streets of Miami

The marketing campaign for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated *GTA6* is officially underway, and it is shaping up to be as wild as fans have come to expect. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet IGN Games, Rockstar's latest promotional push involves driving modded real-life vehicles directly through the streets of Miami.

## A Bold Approach to Real-World Marketing

Rockstar has always been known for pushing boundaries when it comes to promoting the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise. By taking real-world cars and modifying them to closely resemble the vehicles featured in *GTA6*, the studio has successfully blurred the line between the virtual game world and reality. Spotted cruising through Miami—the very real-world inspiration behind the game's setting—these custom vehicles have turned heads and generated massive buzz online.

Industry observers note that this immersive, on-the-ground marketing strategy is designed to capture widespread attention across social media platforms as the hype surrounding the title continues to build exponentially.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's decision to bring modified GTA6-style cars to the streets of Miami is a brilliant marketing move. It leans heavily into the franchise's chaotic real-world identity and creates authentic viral moments. It is a thrilling sign that the marketing machine is fully operational.
